name: Dream Dwarf
sourceDistinctions: The Dream Dwarf is identified as a dwarf subrace. Page 89 gives 90-ft. darkvision, Dream Sight and grounded Spell Power.
Dream Sight distinguishes ethereal creatures visually. The trait supplies no separate ability to interact across planes.
Spell Power modifies caster level for divinations and earth-descriptor spells while grounded. It does not directly change save DCs or grant spells.
The printed adventure seed names a Dream Dwarf druid without stats. The two staged NPCs are original.
portraitForm: Maera Dol-Vel, an original Dream Dwarf Druid
